headline: Centrum Capital issues 1.17 crore shares to promoter group
hook: Promoter increases stake in Centrum Capital
summary: Centrum Capital has allotted 1.17 crore equity shares to its promoter entity, JBCG Advisory Services. The allotment follows the conversion of warrants issued earlier at a price of ₹28.52 per share. The promoter group paid the remaining balance of ₹24.99 crore to complete the transaction. This capital infusion increases the promoter's holding in the financial services firm.
why_it_matters: Promoter stake increase signals long-term confidence in the firm

headline: Centrum Capital allots 1.16 crore equity shares on warrant conversion
summary: Centrum Capital Limited has announced the allotment of 11,687,704 equity shares following the exercise of warrants by investors. This allotment increases the company's total paid-up equity base. Existing shareholders will experience equity dilution as a result of the new share creation. Retail investors tracking financial services companies should note changes in capital structure.
why_it_matters: Equity dilution affects your per-share value in Centrum Capital
